project_name: CAUL AI — Cauldron Growth OS Command Center (Phase 1A)
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL COMMAND CENTER
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a serious, high-contrast tactical security & compliance governance command center for executive, admin, and compliance officers.
MUST display a prominent, sticky global warning banner: 'AUTH STUB — NOT PRODUCTION' at the very top of all screens.

MUST implement 4 foundation pages for Phase 1A: 1) Labeled Dev Auth Stub Login, 2) Governance Dashboard, 3) AI Recommendations & Approvals (List + Detail view), 4) Tamper-Evident Hash-Chained Audit Log (Read-only, searchable, filterable, exportable).
MUST provide navigation items for secondary system pages: Emergency Controls, Connectors (all Not Connected), Policies, Admin Users & Roles, and Settings ($24.99/mo subscription, 2.30% fee).
MUST support full state machine handling across all UI views: empty, loading, error, disconnected, pending, approved, rejected, failed, paused, and demo/stub states.
All interactive elements and key compliance metrics MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Use React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/ui components customized with dark slate tactical panels and monospaced cryptographic digest displays.

scale.code_digest: font-mono text-xs text-emerald-400 bg-slate-950 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-800

visual_enhancers.cryptographic_badge: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-mono text-xs bg-emerald-950/60 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-800/50
visual_enhancers.stub_warning_banner: bg-amber-500/10 border-b border-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono flex items-center justify-between

grids.dashboard_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-6

layouts.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-950 border-r border-slate-800 min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between p-4
layouts.top_navbar: h-14 bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between px-6 z-40 sticky top-0

accessibility.min_contrast_ratio: 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large headers

image_urls.description: Illuminated server racks for enterprise infrastructure representation
Dark mode server rack details for governance dashboard visuals

states_requirements.empty: Render tailored empty-state panels with diagnostic clear-filter buttons and governance explanatory notes.
states_requirements.loading: Use dark translucent Skeleton loaders matching component structural dimensions.
states_requirements.error: Display red-tinted alert boxes with error codes, timestamp, and hash-retry triggers.
states_requirements.disconnected: Show amber/red status badges for disconnected connectors with re-authentication prompts.
states_requirements.pending: Amber pill badges with pulse animations indicating required executive authorization.
states_requirements.approved: Emerald green badges with hash signature verification timestamp.
states_requirements.rejected: Slate dark red badges with recorded rejection reason & auditor identity.
states_requirements.failed: Bright crimson error badges with stack digest preview.
states_requirements.paused: Purple warning banners and lock indicators when Emergency Global Pause is engaged.
states_requirements.demo_stub: Visible 'STUB USER' pill next to active user profile with quick role switcher.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always set explicit hover text colors to prevent invisible text (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Ensure every interactive element (button, select, table row, input, tab, filter, modal) has a valid data-testid attribute.
Never use generic centered layouts or plain light backgrounds for this enterprise app.
Ensure cryptographic hashes use monospaced fonts with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
Audit log table must clearly show chain-verification status (e.g. Genesis Hash, Chain Verified, Broken Link Alert).
